title: Use CapCut’s AI Video feature (Seedance 2.5) to generate the world/setting for…
content:
Use CapCut’s AI Video feature (Seedance 2.5) to generate the world/setting for your story.  
Use CapCut’s AI Extend to expand an opening scene into a longer narrative sequence.  
Use CapCut’s AI Edit to polish details and finalize the film (transitions, pacing, ending).  
Before finalizing, review the full cut and ensure each scene advances the story, each transition has a purpose, and the ending feels earned.  
Start from the official opening provided for the challenge, then build your own world from it.
